title: 第十一章 迅速凑钱
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
迅速清点了一番领民带回来的资源。

    不算多也不算少，毕竟只在营地附近3公里的范围内，这一片范围内，他把所有的领民都安排出去了，互相之间负责不同的资源点。

    就算他有这样的安排，也因为这片范围实在算不上大，收获的资源比较有限。

    这些材料，都是那种比较基础的木材石材，配合上穿云狙击塔自动防护着周围的范围，现在算上肉类在内，差不多是足够时光耕地的建造材料的。

    只是...元素石这方面，确实就有些欠缺！

    之前他带着石镐去进行过简单的开采，确实有开采出相应的元素石，但是只有一个土系的元素石，除此之外，这是今日领民在外开采时，有开采到一颗火系元素石。

    照这样看来的话...这种稀有资源的爆率，算不上有多高！

    照这样开采下去，要想凑齐这几种不同的属性，必然会花费一些时间！

    而时光更耕地本身就是能够大幅强化时间流速的建筑，更别说根据他自己的实验，哪怕是这类建筑，也是可以通过自己的天赋进行进化的！

    这建筑默认建造出来就有1:10倍的时间流速，要是经过强化以后，会有怎样的效果，他都有点不敢想了！

    所以在建造这种东西上耽误时间，对于其能产出的东西而言，至少就相当于是几十上百倍的浪费！

    正常过一天就相当于浪费10天！

    这谁顶得住？！

    所以，对于秦天而言，现在自己首要考虑的，就是要先把这个东西给做出来，在这上面大幅度节约时间，最后获得收获的时候，才会把收益最大化！

    计划是这样的，只是，这些素材的获取数量，让他意识到在这个爆率下，要想凑到这些相应的元素石，把这些东西给凑齐，也不是一件简单的事。

    既然如此，那还不如自己想点办法，赶紧把这些东西给弄到手。

    现在只有二十个领民，开采速度和爆率虽然不高，但是世界频道上，有不少人在呢！

    他们觉醒出来的天赋，各种各样的都有，甚至有些人的天赋，本身并不是很适合发展，是比较偏向生活辅助系职业，乍一看没有什么太大的用。
content_en:
He quickly took stock of the resources brought back by the people.

    Not too much, not too little. After all, it was only within 3 kilometers of the camp. Within this area, he arranged for all the residents to be responsible for different resource points.

    Even if he has such an arrangement, it is because the area is not really large and the resources he can harvest are relatively limited.

    These materials are all relatively basic wood and stone. Together with the cloud-piercing sniper tower, which automatically protects the surrounding area, including meat, it is almost enough construction materials to cultivate land.

    It's just... that there is indeed some shortcomings in terms of elemental stones!

    He had carried out simple mining with a stone pickaxe before, and he had indeed mined the corresponding elemental stone, but there was only one earth-type elemental stone. In addition, this is the day when the people of the territory were mining outside, they mined a fire-type elemental stone.

    From this perspective...the explosion rate of this rare resource is not that high!

    If you continue to mine like this, it will definitely take some time to gather these different attributes!

    The Time Generator itself is a building that can greatly enhance the flow of time, not to mention that according to his own experiments, even this type of building can be evolved through his own talent!

    This building has a time flow rate of 1:10 times by default. If it is strengthened, he can't even imagine what effect it will have!

    Therefore, wasting time in building this kind of thing is equivalent to at least dozens or hundreds of times of waste in terms of what it can produce!

    A normal day is equivalent to wasting 10 days!

    Who can withstand this? !

    Therefore, for Qin Tian, ​​his first priority now is to make this thing first, save a lot of time on it, and maximize the benefits when he finally reaps the rewards!

    This was the plan, but the amount of these materials made him realize that under this explosion rate, it was not an easy task to get the corresponding elemental stones and put these things together.

    In this case, it is better to think of some way to get these things quickly.

    There are only twenty territorial citizens now. Although the mining speed and explosion rate are not high, there are many people on the world channel!

    The talents they awaken are of all kinds, and some people's talents are not very suitable for development in themselves. They are more inclined to assisted living professions, and at first glance they are not of much use.
